name: Lucas Errant
source: A transfer student from Darkwick's sister school in the UK, Lucas is friendly, honest, and chivalrous, but tends to lose perspective when anomalies are involved. Any mention of demons lights a cold fire in his heart. He is searching for his twin brother.
